mission: Han and Leia on the Falcon tracking the Corellian political pressure; the marriage strain articulates one more step.
why_now: Saxan's speech has gone public; Han watches it from the Falcon.
opening_hook: Han in the cockpit with the speech replay paused on a small screen, Leia behind him in the hatchway.
conflict: Han's sympathy with Saxan's line versus Leia's institutional grasp of what the Alliance will now do.
turning_point: Han says he would have voted with Saxan; Leia tells him an Alliance vote is not the question.
closing_hook: Han rewinding the speech to watch it again.
setting: Millennium Falcon cockpit; night pad lighting.
sensory_details: Cockpit glow from the replay screen; the Falcon's off-watch hum; Leia's hand on the hatch frame.
emotional_trajectory: Shared attention → disagreement named → silent replay.

stakes.external: The Corellian situation as domestic-Solo question.

notes: The book builds the split by small domestic increments.
